description: This Kotlin source file defines an abstract test class for database-related tests in an Android project. It sets up an in-memory Room database, provides DAOs for notifications and topics, and handles cleanup after tests.

classes.name: DatabaseTest
classes.description: An abstract class for setting up and tearing down an in-memory Room database for testing purposes. It initializes DAOs for news resources and topics.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the in-memory database and DAOs before each test.

methods.name: teardown
